name: Tokonatsu Shimai Sand
source: While vacationing on an island with his sisters they search ancient ruins and uncover a deity. After awakening the deity they soon find out they are trapped on the island alone with no way of reaching the outside world. The deity promises to help them but doesn't have enough power. She needs power of love meaning the sibling have to have sex if they want to get off the island.
